basic_details.job_title: CJH Tihar Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 20 Senior Resident, Junior Resident Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Central Jail Hospital, Tihar is filling 20 posts of doctors in Delhi Prisons on an ad-hoc basis: 7 Sr. Residents and 13 Jr. Residents (MBBS). Send the filled application form and documents by Speed Post, or hand them in, at the R&I Section, Prison Head Quarter, Near Lajwanti Garden Chowk, Janak Puri, New Delhi-110058, latest by 29 October 2026. Forms by hand are taken between 10:00 AM and 05:00 PM, Monday to Friday. The Sr. Resident interviews are on 2 November 2026 and the Jr. Resident interviews on 3 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: About CJH Tihar
content_sections.text: The Central Jail Hospital, Tihar is part of Delhi Prisons under the Govt. of NCT of Delhi. Its office is the Office of the Resident Medical Officer, Central Jail Hospital, Tihar, New Delhi-110064. The application form for these posts is headed "Prisons Department, Govt. of NCT of Delhi".

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the filled application form with the required documents by Speed Post, or hand it in, at this address: R&I Section, Prison Head Quarter, Near Lajwanti Garden Chowk, Janak Puri, New Delhi-110058. The form must be in by 29 October 2026. Forms by hand are accepted between 10:00 AM and 05:00 PM, Monday to Friday. Use the "Application Proforma for the post of Sr./Jr. Resident (MBBS)" on page 5 of the notification. It asks for: A passport size photograph, affixed in the box Name of the candidate (in capital), Father's/Husband name, date of birth, postal address and permanent address Contact number, Aadhar number and email ID Date of completion of internship and category (UR/EWS/SC/ST/OBC) Any earlier work as a Sr./Jr. Resident, with the post, period and name of the hospital or institute ("Nil" if none) Qualifications from Class 10 onwards: total marks obtained, percentage of marks, college/university, year of passing and number of attempts Delhi Medical Council Registration/Acknowledgement number A signed declaration, a list of enclosures, and the candidate's name and signature Under the declaration, an application or selection is liable to be cancelled at any time if any information in it is found to be fake or incorrect.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CJH Tihar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 20 vacancies: 07 Sr. Residents (Medicine 03, Orthopedics 01, Psychiatry 01, Ophthalmology 01, Pathology 01) and 13 Jr. Residents (MBBS). The number of vacancies may vary at any stage.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application form must be submitted by Speed Post or by hand latest by 29 October 2026. Forms by hand are accepted between 10:00 AM and 05:00 PM, Monday to Friday.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Sr. Resident post?
faq.answer: A Post Graduate Degree (MD/MS/DNB)/Diploma in the concerned specialty. If no PG candidates are available, MBBS graduates with at least 02 years' experience from a Govt./Govt. Empanelled Hospital, 01 year of it in the concerned specialty, may be considered.

faq.question: Q4. Who is eligible for the Jr. Resident (MBBS) post?
faq.answer: Candidates with MBBS and a 01-year internship completed on or after 29 October 2024 are eligible. FMGs with a foreign internship qualify based on their date of passing the FMGE. A DMC registration certificate is required when applying, though a valid DMC acknowledgement receipt is accepted for the interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for CJH Tihar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 45 years for Sr. Residents and 30 years for Jr. Residents of the General/EWS category, both as on 29 October 2026. There is a relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST candidates, 03 years for OBC (Delhi only) and 5 years for qualified Ex-Service personnel with at least 5 years' continuous service.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of Sr. and Jr. Residents at Tihar Jail Hospital?
faq.answer: Sr. Residents get Pay Matrix Level-11 (Rs. 67,700-208700) plus other admissible allowances per month under the residency scheme. Jr. Residents get Pay level 10 (Rs. 56100-Rs. 177500/-) plus usual allowances as per rules/residency rules.

faq.question: Q7. Are allowances paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes. Sr. Residents get other admissible allowances under the residency scheme, and Jr. Residents get the usual allowances as per rules/residency rules. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that there is no fee for appearing in the interview.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected, and when are the interviews?
faq.answer: Selection is by interview at the Conference Hall, Prison Head Quarter, Janak Puri, New Delhi-110058. Sr. Residents are interviewed on 2 November 2026 and Jr. Residents on 3 November 2026. Candidates must report between 10:00 AM and 11:00 AM, and no one is allowed in after 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The posts are ad-hoc, initially for 44 days or until the Centralized Recruitment Committee under the Dean, MAMC makes its selection, whichever is earlier. The term may be extended by 44 days at a time, up to 03 years for Sr. Residents and 01 year for Jr. Residents.
